lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense distribution of high-luminance, quasi-circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows that become more widely spaced towards the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are discernible, intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a grid-like lattice, with the spots acting as high-intensity nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple Echeneidae (remora) individuals are visible; one is positioned near the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills, and a group of approximately six individuals is swimming adjacent to the pectoral fin.
